title: Guardnet Demo
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.desktop: passed: 1440x1000, four columns, no horizontal overflow
checks.mobile: passed: 390x844, two columns, no horizontal overflow
checks.interactions: passed: ghost hover, keyboard focus, all three button clicks
checks.font: Futura Md BT Medium loaded in both viewports
checks.video: playing, muted, looping, readyState 4; time advanced in both viewports

asset_issues: Chromium recorded two net::ERR_ABORTED video requests per viewport during loading; the exact remote video subsequently loaded and played successfully. No HTTP asset errors or font loading failures were observed.
notes: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. Only the two requested sections were implemented.
Exact video URL, font import, SVG paths, supplied copy and responsive classes retained.
Buttons have no application workflow because none is specified by PROMPT.md.
Remote video and font require continued availability of their original hosts.
No agents, additional sessions, deployment, push, or messages to others. All project writes stayed within this directory.
